The announcement comes as Ford has been touting its U.S. manufacturing, especially with President Donald Trump 's automotive tariffs and uncertainty with the USMCA North American trade deal . Farley previously told CNBC that he wants Ford to be awarded for its efforts to largely produce their vehicles domestically, and other automakers that rely on imported vehicles — like General Motors and Toyota Motor — should face more penalties.
